note: Font Awesome Iconpicker provides a field widget (fontawesome_iconpicker) and formatter (fontawesome_iconpicker_formatter_type) for core text/string fields. No settings page (configure=null). Widget settings: type (default|component), size (int), placeholder. Formatter setting: size (fa-1x..fa-5x). Output <i class="fa <icon> <size>"> via the fontawesome_iconpicker_formatter theme hook. Config is stored on entity_form_display (widget) and entity_view_display (formatter). Live-state cases add namespaced string fields (field_faip_*) to the Article content type and set the widget/formatter, cleaned up by deleting only those fields. Depends on the contrib fontawesome module + external d34dman/vanilla-icon-picker library.

evals.prompt: On which kinds of Drupal field can the fontawesome_iconpicker widget and formatter be used?
evals.expected_output: Both the widget and formatter support core text and string field types (i.e. Text (plain) / Text (formatted)). Text (plain) is recommended. You store the icon's class string in the field.

evals.prompt: There is no settings page for fontawesome_iconpicker. How do I actually give editors the icon picker on a field?
evals.expected_output: Add a text/string field to the bundle, then on Manage form display set that field's widget to 'Font Awesome Icon Picker' (id fontawesome_iconpicker). Optionally set the matching 'Font Awesome Icon Picker' formatter on Manage display to render the chosen icon.

evals.prompt: How does the fontawesome_iconpicker formatter render a stored icon value, and what markup does it produce?
evals.expected_output: The formatter (fontawesome_iconpicker_formatter_type) renders via the fontawesome_iconpicker_formatter theme hook to , where is one of fa-1x..fa-5x.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, which field on the Article content type uses the Font Awesome Icon Picker widget on its default edit form? Inspect the live form-display configuration and give the field machine name.
evals.expected_output: field_faip_known: in core.entity_form_display.node.article.default its component has type fontawesome_iconpicker.

evals.prompt: On this site, the Article field field_faip_size is displayed with the Font Awesome Icon Picker formatter. At what icon size is it configured to render? Inspect the live display configuration and answer.
evals.expected_output: fa-4x: in core.entity_view_display.node.article.default the field_faip_size component (formatter fontawesome_iconpicker_formatter_type) has settings.size = fa-4x.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the Article content type has a plain-text field field_faip_task. Using the fontawesome_iconpicker module, make that field use the Font Awesome Icon Picker widget on the default edit form. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set the field_faip_task component's widget to fontawesome_iconpicker in core.entity_form_display.node.article.default (via Manage form display, or setComponent type=fontawesome_iconpicker). Verified when the component type is fontawesome_iconpicker.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the Article content type has a field field_faip_display. Using the fontawesome_iconpicker module, configure the default display so this field renders as a Font Awesome icon at size 2x. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set the field_faip_display component in core.entity_view_display.node.article.default to formatter fontawesome_iconpicker_formatter_type with settings.size = fa-2x. Verified when the formatter type is fontawesome_iconpicker_formatter_type and size is fa-2x.
